pending-clause.answer: Read §2002:8.8.1.1 (evaluation order and the exponentiation exceptions, mode-independent), §2002:8.8.1.3.1 with §2002:8.8.1.3.1.1 (32-digit standard intermediate) and §2002:8.8.1.3.1.3 (rounding to 31 digits on compare, on a function argument with no equivalent expression, on a store without ROUNDED), §2002:8.8.1.3.6 (exponentiation), and §2002:15 / §2002:15.1 (the same six function types; 2002 15.1 says the definition gives an alphanumeric/national function's character positions). STANDARD-COMPARE is an alphanumeric function, and 2002 15.1's requirement that the definition give the character positions is met by RV7 itself (length 1); no arithmetic is involved.
